title: OpenDocBot brings a bring-your-own-model agent to Microsoft Office
friendlyTitle: OpenDocBot adds your choice of AI model to Office
summary: OpenDocBot is an early-access, client-side add-in for Word, Excel and PowerPoint that supports cloud models and local Ollama endpoints. It offers an optional approval gate before edits and publishes its source for inspection, though installation currently requires sideloading.
friendlySummary: This early tool works inside Word, Excel and PowerPoint. You can connect a cloud AI service or a local model and approve changes before they happen.
whyItMatters: It offers a practical route to use local or chosen models inside familiar office files without sending documents through an extra vendor server. Users still need to assess the selected model provider, the fair-code licence and early-access limitations.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It gives you more choice and control over where document data goes. Setup is still technical, and the product is not yet a finished marketplace app.
